plugins.text: Plugins add to what you can do here. Each runs apart from your files and keys, and does only what you allowed when you added it.
plugins.right.watch: See everything in your conversations as it is kept: all that is written in them, the files you share, and each action before it runs
plugins.right.draw: Show things of its own here
plugins.right.change: Change what it sees before it goes on
plugins.right.refuse: Stop an action, or ask you first
plugins.right.loosen: Let actions go ahead without asking you first
plugins.error.address: That isn’t the address of a plugin.
plugins.error.fetch: It couldn’t be read from there.
plugins.error.format: It is made for another version.
plugins.error.name: Its name can only have lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
plugins.error.main: Its code must be a JavaScript file beside its plugin.json.
plugins.error.rights: It asks for something plugins can’t do.
plugins.failed: {title} didn’t start, so it is off for now.
plugins.confirmRemove: Remove {title}? What it kept goes with it.
